summary: Technical Review Gate completed with independent adversarial audit. Identified 7 scoped revision issues (6 MAJOR, 1 MINOR) spanning unapproved numerical thresholds in IEEE 519 (Section 6.3), claim map synchronization discrepancies (CLM-011, CLM-013), unsupported transient duration (Section 6.1), ungrounded bypass contactor durability claim (Section 5.2), mid-sentence citation placement violations under ADR-013 Gate 5, and citation first-appearance sequence anomalies.

checks.name: Research Package Consistency & Preconditions
checks.details: Preconditions verified: 7/7 RQs answered, 17 approved EVDs intact, no research conflicts.

checks.name: Claim-to-Evidence Traceability
checks.details: CLM-011 and CLM-013 claim_text exceed approved EVD boundaries (EVD-014 and EVD-016). See REV-002 and REV-005.

checks.name: Full Prose Evidence Boundary
checks.details: Section 6.3 contains unapproved TDD percentages (8%, 12%, 15%, 20%); Section 6.1 contains unsupported duration (5-30s); Section 5.2 contains ungrounded bypass durability claim. See REV-001, REV-003, REV-004.

checks.name: Numerical Claim Verification
checks.details: Unapproved numbers in Section 6.3 (8%, 12%, 15%, 20%, Isc/IL > 1000) and Section 6.1 (5-30s) fail traceability to approved EVDs.

checks.name: Formula & SI Dimensional Analysis
checks.details: Starting torque Eq (1) and THDi Eq (2) are dimensionally consistent with defined SI units and KaTeX syntax.

checks.name: IEEE In-Text Citation Placement (ADR-013 Gate 5)
checks.details: Multiple in-text citations located mid-sentence (Lines 5, 165, 242, 246, 256) violating Gate 5. See REV-006.

checks.name: IEEE Citation Numbering & Appearance Order
checks.details: Citation [3] appears before [2] in Executive Summary and Section 2.1; [3] in Section 2.1 is unmapped in claim map. See REV-007.

checks.name: Locator Verification
checks.details: All verified citations point to verified locators (pages, sections, tables) in evidence.json.

checks.name: Source Policy & Quality (ADR-024)
checks.details: 6 accepted sources (5 Tier 1, 1 Tier 3 supplementary), high-tier ratio 83.3% >= 70%.

checks.name: Canonical Blog Taxonomy (BLOG-T04 Comparison)
checks.details: Structural comparison logic, balanced trade-offs, conditional selection framework intact.
